lectures.title: The Domain Name System (DNS) Protocol: Resolving Domain Names to IP Addresses

cues.en: In this lecture.
We want to have a look at the DNS protocol, the so called domain name system.
The domain name system.
It's an application layer protocol according to the OSI model.
And the idea here is that we are able to translate domain names to IP addresses.
It thus facilitates human readable access to websites and services.
